Enterprise AI & Knowledge Engineering

Give technical support answers a traceable source

We build knowledge systems and agent workflows for equipment, manufacturing, and enterprise support teams that resolve document versions, show evidence, and give reviewers a clear handoff.

Business problems

  • The same fault code can require different procedures by equipment version, component, or regional policy.
  • A relevant passage still has to apply to the right product. A wrong manual can lengthen downtime.
  • Cross-system queries may reach data under different permissions. Reviewers need to know which source was used.

Engineering capabilities

  • Model document versions, applicability, source authority, and access permissions.
  • Make retrieval, conflict arbitration, citation verification, and human review replayable workflow steps.
  • Measure answer and citation accuracy, the quality of abstentions, and downstream handling time on representative cases.

Frequently asked questions

Can this run inside our existing system?

We first verify identity, indexing, product-data updates, and support workflows, then choose how to integrate with your private environment or existing platform.

Can you evaluate our existing RAG system?

Yes. The evaluation tests retrieval, correct version choice, and whether the answer is supported by its citations separately.
